Name: Amor Seco Essence
Description: Restores 50 to 60 HP to all allies.

Name: Antidotal Herb
Description: Cures a single ally of poison and severe poison.

Name: Avabranche
Description: A chilly branch that seems to be wreathed in winter.

Name: Beast Bone
Description: A sturdy bone from a wild beast.

Name: Belle Cap
Description: A mushroom of heartbreaking beauty.

Name: Blue Eye
Description: A precious stone that glows with blue light.

Name: Bonus Ball
Description: Increases the amount of experience points and gold coins earned after battle by 1.5x. Effective for 10 battles. Only one of this or similar items can be in effect at any one time.

Name: Celestial Skein
Description: Transcendental fibres that flow like fluid.

Name: Copper Ore
Description: Common ore rich in copper.

Name: Cottontop
Description: A fluffy tuft of top-grade cotton.

Name: Densinium
Description: A mass of metal that's much heavier than it looks.

Name: Faerie Fluff
Description: Fluffy stuff farmed by the fairest faerie folk.

Name: Fine Fur
Description: Toasty-warm fur once worn by a monster.

Name: Flintstone
Description: A big, heavy stone that's ideal for squishing sandwiches.

Name: Flurry Feather
Description: A plume lost in high winds by a bird on the wing.

Name: Fresh Water
Description: Natural spring water, cool and clear.

Name: Glass Frit
Description: Soft sand used to polish things till they gleam.

Name: Green Eye
Description: A precious stone that glows with green light.

Name: Hardy Hide
Description: A tough pelt of the kind formerly found on monsters.

Name: Iron Ore
Description: Common ore rich in iron.

Name: Lambswool
Description: Fluffy wool from a tender young sheep.

Name: Lamplight
Description: Flames that flicker with magical force.

Name: Manky Meat
Description: A piece of putrid flesh that exudes a sour stench. Feed to a monster to very slightly increase the likelihood of it wanting to join you, but also poison it in the process.

Name: Maximising Seed
Description: Changes a single ally to L size.

Name: Medicinal Herb
Description: Restores 30 HP to a single ally.

Name: Mini Medal
Description: Can be traded with Monsieur Medaille for rewards at the Mini Medal Swap Shop.

Name: Minimising Seed
Description: Changes a single ally to S size.

Name: Mirrorstone
Description: Rock that reflects light as well as any mirror.

Name: Monster Manure
Description: A pongy deposit that can be pitched at one's opponents. Inflicts minor damage to a single enemy when used in battle.

Name: Monster Munchies
Description: A meaty morsel that monsters love. Feed to a monster to very slightly increase the likelihood of it wanting to join you.

Name: Moonwort Bulb
Description: Cures a single ally of paralysis.

Name: Mystery Meat
Description: Meat with an oddly familiar taste. Feed to a monster to increase the likelihood of it wanting to join you. Also applies a random effect.

Name: Narspicious
Description: A plant of dubious nature.

Name: Nonconformity for All
Description: A book so idiosyncratic that it changes a monster's personality to <6>nonconformist<9>. The monster will develop high max. HP and defence.

Name: Pale Pearl
Description: A perfect pearl, pure and milky white.

Name: Pinball
Description: A sphere of the toughest stone that really hurts if it hits you. Inflicts minor damage to a single enemy when used in battle, including metallic monsters.

Name: Pink Pine
Description: A slender bough that's long and lovely.

Name: Pretty Pebble
Description: A small stone that can sting quite sharply if thrown with enough force. Inflicts minor damage to a single enemy when used in battle.

Name: Professional Development
Description: A book so competent that it changes a monster's personality to <6>professional<9>. The monster's attributes will develop in a balanced way.

Name: Purple Eye
Description: A precious stone that glimmers with purple light.

Name: Red Eye
Description: A precious stone that radiates bright red light.

Name: Ring of Impulse
JapaneseName: ちからとすばやさのゆびわ
Description: Slightly increases attack and agility.

Name: Ring of Life
Description: Slightly increases max. HP.

Name: Ring of Magic
Description: Slightly increases max. MP.

Name: Ring of Strength
Description: Slightly increases attack.

Name: Royal Soil
Description: A clump of soil with thaumaturgic properties.

Name: Seed of Agility
Description: Raises the agility of a single ally by 3. Note that each monster type has an upper limit to its agility that cannot be exceeded.

Name: Seed of Growth
Description: Raises the level of a single ally by 1.

Name: Seed of Life
Description: Raises the max. HP of a single ally by 3. Note that each monster type has an upper limit to its max. HP that cannot be exceeded.

Name: Seed of Magic
Description: Raises the max. MP of a single ally by 3. Note that each monster type has an upper limit to its max. MP that cannot be exceeded.

Name: Seed of Resilience
Description: Raises the defence of a single ally by 3. Note that each monster type has an upper limit to its defence that cannot be exceeded.

Name: Seed of Skill
Description: Provides a single ally with 3 additional talent points. Note that a monster can have a maximum of 999 available talent points.

Name: Seed of Strength
Description: Raises the attack of a single ally by 3. Note that each monster type has an upper limit to its attack that cannot be exceeded.

Name: Seed of Wisdom
Description: Raises the wisdom of a single ally by 3. Note that each monster type has an upper limit to its wisdom that cannot be exceeded.

Name: Shallow Breather's Scroll
Description: Teaches the Shallow Breather talent.

Name: Single Phial
Description: Restores 10 MP to a single ally.

Name: Slimedrop
Description: Jelly that quivers like a shivering slime.

Name: Small Scale
Description: A teensy tiny scale the size of a fingernail.

Name: Smoked Sirloin
Description: A tender treat that monsters adore. Feed to a monster to slightly increase the likelihood of it wanting to join you.

Name: Snakeskin
Description: A skin shed by its serpentine former owner.

Name: Sparkly Sap
Description: Sap from a tree that glows in the moonlight.

Name: Startle Dart
Description: Cures a single ally of confusion and sleep.

Name: Strong Medicine
Description: Restores 60 HP to a single ally.

Name: Sun-Bleached Seashell
Description: A shell found on the beach that's white as bone.

Name: The 20/20 Visionary
Description: A book so forward-thinking that it changes a monster's personality to <6>visionary<9>. The monster will develop very high max. MP.

Name: Thunderball
Description: A crystal globe formed through the power of lightning.

Name: Toad Oil
Description: Oil obtained from a toad (don't ask how).

Name: Waveweed
Description: Rhythmically reeling grass that reeks of the receding tide.

Name: Wing of Bat
Description: A leathery wing from a fly-by-night supplier.

Name: Yellow Eye
Description: A precious stone that gleams with yellow light.
